title: 1328. Break a Palindrome

examples.explanation: There are many ways to make "abccba" not a palindrome, such as "zbccba", "aaccba", and "abacba". Of all the ways, "aaccba" is the lexicographically smallest.
There is no way to replace a single character to make "a" not a palindrome, so return an empty string.
